hints.content: Each year, the painting's value grows by a constant **ratio**, so it is best to use an exponential graph to model it.
An increasing exponential graph curves more steeply upward as $x$ increases.

The graph that best represents the relationship between time and the painting's value is:

![An increasing graph that curves more steeply as x increases.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/51e01ed550d02d785b066d3b55a8d3b8fcd5df3b)

question.content:
Bao has an original oil painting worth $30{,}000$ Chinese Yuan.  Each year the painting's value increases by $15\%$.

**Which graph best represents the relationship between time and the painting's value?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: ![An increasing graph with a constant, positive slope.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/0c0eacf9b0cb2c11e45724a1d302de5097f4059e)
![An increasing graph that curves more steeply as x increases.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/51e01ed550d02d785b066d3b55a8d3b8fcd5df3b)
